verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.statsig.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Statsig documentation index. Statsig also documents a dedicated Docs MCP server at /api/mcp that lets AI clients read public docs directly, with no API key required. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, and no independent community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.
